generator: Built-in image_gen; one 2×2 transparent source sheet per action and direction

delivery.layout: horizontal strips; body-referenced scale where weapons extend beyond the silhouette; shared foot anchor at actor y+12; 48px death and 64px shoot canvases retain physical body scale
delivery.west: Mirror east; do not rotate canvas

idle.name: 待机
idle.poses: Frame 1 relaxed standing with rifle ready and feet planted. Frame 2 a very small breathing lift of shoulders, one logical pixel only; same feet and head position. This is a calm seamless loop.

walk.name: 行走
walk.poses: Frame 1 left foot leading, right arm slightly back while holding rifle. Frame 2 feet pass under body. Frame 3 right foot leading, opposite leg swing. Frame 4 passing stance opposite frame 2. Clear alternating legs, tiny body bob, stable rifle aim. Seamless 4-frame walking loop.

shoot.name: 射击
shoot.poses: Frame 1 rifle fired and kicked back into shoulder, torso braced, arms visibly recoiling. Frame 2 rifle and shoulders recover toward the aiming pose. No baked muzzle flash; the game already draws that effect. Feet stay planted.

hurt.name: 受击
hurt.poses: Frame 1 torso flinches away from impact with shoulder jerk and rifle lowered a little. Frame 2 regains balance and raises rifle. Same outfit colours, NO red/white palette swap or blood spray, readable changed body pose.

death.name: 死亡
death.poses: Frame 1 standing hit reaction, knees beginning to buckle. Frame 2 dropping onto one knee, rifle lowered. Frame 3 body collapsing to the ground. Frame 4 lying fully down, motionless, rifle at side. Clear loss of height and final horizontal fallen silhouette; not four standing characters. No gore.

loot.name: 搜刮
loot.poses: Frame 1 crouches/kneels and reaches forward with free hand. Frame 2 leans forward rummaging with both hands, rifle slung close. Frame 3 draws one hand back then returns toward reach. Same feet/ground contact point. Do NOT draw the container or any environment. Seamless search loop.

dodge.name: 闪避
dodge.poses: Frame 1 low forward lean ready to dodge. Frame 2 tucked compact sideways shoulder roll with rifle held close. Frame 3 low landing crouch and starting to stand. Same camera and facing, clear compressed rolling silhouette in frame 2. No motion blur or afterimages.
